title: Ambitionz: AI Game Creation Tools - Seeking Our First 200 Founding Members
author: pavelbains
selftext:
Hey fellow creators,

We're Ambitionz - a team from Unity, Xbox, EA, Valve and Activision building AI tools that let anyone create professional game assets without specialized skills.

# What We're Building:

AI-powered tools for generating 2D/3D assets, music, voice overs, and narrative content - designed by the devs behind Battlefield, Halo, FIFA, and LEGO games.

# Why Join Now:

* **Founding Member status** (limited to first 200 qualifying members on Discord)
* **Free credits** when we launch next month
* **Large discounts** on future pricing plans
* **Direct product influence** through exclusive dev team access
* **Early feature access** before public release

# What You'll Get:

Our public site is vague as it reveals features chapter-by-chapter, but Founding Members get the inside track on everything we're developing while still experiencing each reveal alongside our growing community.

# Current Status:

Private alpha launching in \~4 weeks. Founding Members get first access.

# Discord Community:

* Custom roles for Gamers, Streamers, and Developers
* Level-based progression system
* "First Movers" designation for Founding Members

# Learn More:

📚 [Gitbook Documentation](https://docs.ambitionz.ai) \- See product vision, screenshots, tech approach, and team bios

🔗 [Join Our Discord](http://discord.gg/ambitionz)

Questions? We're happy to answer in the comments or Discord!
